name: shared-yaml-error-position
body:
Resolving the offending source line of a yaml.v3 parse error — and, when the failure is the plain-scalar quoting problem, the quoting hint — is defined once and used by the three loaders that report a positioned YAML error: the template library loader (internal/template/yamlerror.go, template.parseLibraryErrorLine), the slide and section frontmatter parser (internal/slide/yamlerror.go, slide.yamlErrorWithLine) and the deck config loader (internal/deck/yamlerror.go, deck.yamlErrorWithLine). Each loader keeps its own positioned error type and its own rendered form (`<file>:<line>: …` for the deck config; `<file>:<line>[ › <path>]: invalid YAML: <problem> (<hint>)` for slide/section frontmatter and a library manifest), and the shared resolver returns the line, the undefined-anchor line and the quoting hint they consume. It matches the `yaml: line N:` prefix, strips that prefix so the line is not rendered twice, recovers the line of an undefined-anchor error from the source text, and recognises a plain scalar YAML would read as something other than the author's literal text.

AC: all three loaders call one shared position-and-hint resolver; a malformed kalide.yaml, slide frontmatter and library manifest each render their own positioned message with the resolved line and, where the plain-scalar problem applies, the quoting hint.
